I can't give you a firm date for either one, and I can't promise funding. Here is where things stand today (month 0):

- Your score is 87 against a threshold of 75, but you're not marked ready yet because two blockers remain.
- Blocker 1, no security: the Kafalah guarantee application is prepared and in progress. Approval takes about a month.
- Blocker 2, overdue receivables: 44% of your receivables (SAR 130,400) are more than 90 days overdue. We send payment reminders every month until the overdue share is within the lender's limit. I can't say how long that will take, because it depends on when your customers pay.
- Already done: the request is lowered to SAR 1,450,000, and the commercial registration renewal is prepared.

So the earliest realistic point is after the Kafalah approval, about a month from now, and only if the overdue share has also come down by then. Once both blockers are cleared, the plan can be rechecked. The lender then makes its own decision and sets its own timing. No lender decision has been made yet.

The most helpful thing you can do now is follow up with the customers who owe you the overdue invoices.
